relationships.evidence_quote: we found s-RhTx was able to potentiate the effect of capsaicin (10 nM) in a concentration-dependent manner in whole-cell patch-clamp recording

relationships.subject: s-RhTx
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that desensitization induced by the cocktail of capsaicin and s-RhTx was remarkably slowed down compared with desensitization upon capsaicin

relationships.subject: s-RhTx
relationships.evidence_quote: Our docking results showed R12 and K22 of s-RhTx formed hydrogen bonds with E652 of TRPV1 in two adjacent subunits

key_findings: Engineered peptide s-RhTx is a selective positive allosteric modulator of TRPV1 that potentiates capsaicin and proton activation and slows desensitization without lowering heat threshold
s-RhTx binds the TRPV1 outer pore via E649/E652 and yields long-lasting analgesia in mice
